newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Office buys Disney unit.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Office buys Disney unit.

text.p: U.S. Office Products Co said Tuesday it has bought Childcraft Education Corp from a Walt Disney Co unit for $14.6 million in cash.
U.S. Office Products said Childcraft was purchased from Disney Enterprises Inc. Childcraft will be operated as a separate unit of its School Specialty Inc subsidiary.
School Specialty is the largest distributor of school supply products in the United States with annual sales of about $260 million, U.S. Office Products said.
Childcraft has annual revenues of about $25 million and was purchased for less than six times its operating income.

School Specialty "will continue to consolidate the fragmented $5 billion school supply industry and should deliver significant profits to (U.S. Office Products) in the upcoming quarters," U.S. Office Products chairman Jonathan J. Ledecky said in a written statement.
Ronald E. Suchodolski will remain as head of Childcraft, U.S. Office Products said.
U.S. Office Products said it has annual sales of $3.2 billion with operations in the United States, New Zealand, Australia, Canada and the United Kingdom.
